413-856-4321-8347.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
413-856-4321-8347.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar, Blasting Station and Sela trigger.
Resolve the Sela trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers. Resolve both triggers from this step and step 3, untapping it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

1879-2023-4770-6006.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2457-4289-4365-8201.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

529-1849-5641-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

323-1339-1832-4050.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
323-1339-1832-4050.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding one mana of any color
When the Insect dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

2736-5571-6495--6.description:
Use Zedruu the Greathearted to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat from step 2.
2736-5571-6495--6.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

147-3899-6929.description:
Cast Behold the Sinister Six! by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Behold the Sinister Six!.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Behold the Sinister Six!
Resolve the Behold the Sinister Six! copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

553-5858-7467.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Gandalf.
In response, cast Sudden Setback by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

1203-2613.easyPrerequisites: You have more life than an opponent.
1203-2613.description:
Cast Fire Covenant by {1}{B}{R} and paying an amount of life equal to an opponent's life total, dealing that much damage to Spiteful Sliver.
Spiteful Sliver triggers, dealing that much damage to the opponent.

296-3532-5078-7693.easyPrerequisites:
There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
296-3532-5078-7693.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
The Thirteenth Doctor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2232-4541-4939-5705.manaNeeded: {1} if you control fewer than eight Treasures
2232-4541-4939-5705.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven Treasures.
2232-4541-4939-5705.description:
Activate at least seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least {7}.
Cast Marut by paying at least {7} gained from Treasures, plus an extra up to {1} if needed.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Cloudstone Curio and Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Burning-Tree Emissary from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve Marut. When Marut enters, it triggers, creating a Treasure for each mana from a Treasure spent to cast it.
Cast Burning-Tree Emissary by paying its mana cost.
When Burning-Tree Emissary enters, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Burning-Tree Emissary trigger, adding {R}{G}
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Marut from the battlefield to your hand.
If needed, activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
2232-4541-4939-5705.notes: If you control eight or more Treasures, use eight Treasures to cast Marut, which foregoes step 12.

710-5686-7424.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2034-3490-6996-7399.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-3490-6996-7399.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

3532-3581-5078-7328.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3581-5078-7328.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Donatello triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Donatello.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat.

972-1809-3542.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}.
972-1809-3542.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Palinchron that is an artifact.
When the Palinchron token enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Cast Returned Pastcaller by paying its mana cost.
When Returned Pastcaller enters, it triggers, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Returned Pastcaller and the Palinchron token.
When the Returned Pastcaller and Palinchron tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Returned Pastcaller token's trigger, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Palinchron token's trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat from step 6.
972-1809-3542.notes: If the seven lands can tap to produce {5}{U}{U} or more, this combo will net infinite mana. So long as you produce an extra {U} each loop, you can eventually stop copying Palinchron and copy other creature(s) or artifact(s) instead. You can also create two copies of Returned Pastcaller instead to return other applicable cards to your hand.

1768-5641-5662.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters, Juniper Order Ranger triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale and Juniper Order Ranger.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating an 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Juniper Order Ranger triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Eldrazi Spawn and Juniper Order Ranger.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Reyhan triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 3.

222-308-4871-6798.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Saproling.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
222-308-4871-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing a nontoken creature you control and Slimefoot and Squee.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot abilities
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two of {B}, {R} or {G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

104-2086-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 3 life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-3693-6260.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire, adding {B}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

Activate Flickerform by paying {2}{W}{W}, exiling Wormfang Manta and all Auras attached to it.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Flickerform triggers, returning Wormfang Manta from exile to the battlefield, and then returning all Auras that were attached to Wormfang Manta from exile to the battlefield attached to Wormfang Manta.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Doorkeeper Thrull.
Repeat each turn.

915-5116-5856.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate a Food using Synod Artificer's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping the Food and Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.

2061-2556-3617.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Time Walk each turn.
2061-2556-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall.
When the Mnemonic Wall token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2191-2736-6085.description:
Cast Martyrdom by paying {1}{W}{W}, targeting Altanak.
Activate Zedruu the Greathearted by paying {U}{R}{W}, giving control of Altanak to an opponent.
Activate Altanak an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Altanak triggers that many times, causing an opponent to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.
2191-2736-6085.notes: When the opponent loses the game, you will regain control of Altanak. Therefore, if mana allows, you may repeat this combo from step 2 for another opponent.

413-5011-5326.notablePrerequisites:
Cavalier of Night in exile with a takeover counter on it.
The Master on the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
413-5011-5326.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing The Master.
When The Master dies, its second ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When The Master enters the battlefield, its first ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Master trigger, doing nothing.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger from step 3, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1257-1656-4543.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
1257-1656-4543.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Walking Atlas's ability by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
If the land is mana-producing and enters the battlefield untapped, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Trench Behemoth's ability by returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Necrotic Ooze.
Repeat.

628-997-5523.description:

When Defiant Greatmaw dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Defiant Greatmaw enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, putting two -1/-1 counters on it.
Defiant Greatmaw's second ability triggers, removing a -1/-1 counter from another creature you control.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

2607-2682-2719.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2607-2682-2719.description:
Cast Dire Fleet Ravager by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Dire Fleet Ravager enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each player to lose a third of their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Archfiend of Despair and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger.
Resolve the Archfiend of Despair trigger, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
Each opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

Imotekh the Stormlord's first ability triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {2}.
Repeat.

495-500-4688-4751-4772.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Verdurous Gearhulk and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Verdurous Gearhulk tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, putting at least nine +1/+1 counters on Nested Shambler, and the remaining 23 +1/+1 counters on any creature(s) you control.
Kill Nested Shambler, triggering its ability, creating at least twenty 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Epic Struggle triggers, causing you to win the game.

678-1574-2452.description:
Cast Rot-Tide Gargantua by paying {0}.
When Rot-Tide Gargantua enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Rot-Tide Gargantua dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning it to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

395-2178-3263-4659-4840.notablePrerequisites:
Hanna does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Hanna.
395-2178-3263-4659-4840.description:
Cast Myr Battlesphere by paying {7}.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere, adding {2}.
Myr Battlesphere dies, triggering Hanna, untapping Hanna.
Repeat from step 3 for each of the four Myr creature tokens.
Activate Hanna by paying {3} and tapping it, returning Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-2493-2596-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {B}{B}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Archaeomancer and Peregrine Drake, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Living Death by paying {3}{B}{B}, causing each player to exile all creature cards from their graveyard, sacrifice all creatures they control, then return all cards exiled this way to the battlefield.
Archaeomancer and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Living Death from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands you control.
Repeat.

950-3525-3573.notablePrerequisites:
Fatestitcher does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Fatestitcher.
You control at least two artifacts.
950-3525-3573.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Tolarian Academy.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Fatestitcher.
Repeat any number of times.
